t: This is the Black Cultural Archives in Brixton, an archive and heritage centre devoted to the histories of people of African and Caribbean descent in Britain. The organisation was founded in 1981, and this building opened in 2014. It offers access to the archive collection, learning spaces, and a programme of exhibitions and events. Its founder, Len Garrison, was an educationalist, community activist and historian, whose life's work was to catalogue the development of black British identity and history, and to promote young black writers.
